name: Cable Alternating Triceps Extension
steps: Stand facing away between two low pulleys on a cable machine, grasping a handle in each hand behind your head with elbows pointing up.
Take a staggered stance, brace your core tightly, and keep both upper arms close to your ears.
Extend one elbow straight overhead to press that handle upward while holding the other arm bent.
Lower that handle slowly behind your head, then extend the opposite arm, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your working upper arm still beside your ear rather than flaring your elbow out.
Avoid overarching your lower back as each arm extends overhead.
